node.statement: From 1.4.1 we have min_k A_k <= sum_k p_k A_k, and from 1.4.2 we have sum_k p_k A_k <= 2*N. Transitivity of <= gives min_k A_k <= 2*N. Substituting the definitions A_k := sum_i p_i n(w_i - w_k) and N := sum_i p_i n(w_i) from 1.1, and merely renaming the pivot index k as i*, this is exactly min over i* in {1,...,m} of sum_i p_i n(w_i - w_i*) <= 2*sum_i p_i n(w_i).
